name: mo.js
role: Declarative burst, shape and ripple effects; own timeline, no GSAP-style seek guarantee
summary: Motion graphics library for the web with ready-made bursts, shapes, swirls and stagger, driven by its own Timeline and Tween classes. Renders SVG shapes and HTML elements with retina-sharp output. Good for celebratory particle-like effects with little code. Releases have stalled since 2023, and determinism under external seeking is not documented.
use_when: A one-off confetti or radial burst effect with minimal code
Click-ripple style UI micro-effects on SVG shapes
avoid_when: Anything needing guaranteed seek-by-time capture: GSAP
Particle fields and noise-driven visuals: p5.js or PixiJS
notes: 2026-10-26: GitHub pushes continued to 2026-07-30 but the last npm release (@mojs/core 1.7.1) is 2023-10-06; the unscoped mo.js package is a stale 0.0.2. Seek behaviour not verified.

assessment.rationale: Last release 1.7.1 on 2023-10-06 (about 36 months); repo pushed 2026-07 but no release. Effects are niche, seeking is undocumented, and GSAP or Anime.js cover the need.
